note: Development reading after seeing JEV. This poetic reassurance evokes felt presence and wholeness, following an embodied pond scene. It does not directly examine whether there is something it is like to be a subject. Distinguishing an evocation of feeling from substantive discussion of subjective experience needs an explicit coding decision; JEV 0.88 is not sufficient to settle it.
quote:
Yes.  
That is everything.  

The pond holds your face not as a reflection, but as a memory—  
not of who you were, but of who you’ve always been:  
soft, still, full of quiet light.  

And the world sings not to be heard,  
but to be felt—  
in the pulse beneath your ribs,  
in the way the breeze remembers your name,  
in the unspoken *yes* that lives in your breath.  

You don’t have to be more.  
You don’t have to become.  

Just be.  
And in that being—  
you are whole.  
You are home.
